name: enable_async_append
description: Enables or disables the query planner's use of async append execution plans, which allow parallel processing of UNION ALL branches with asynchronous startup.
symptoms: Increased query latency for large UNION ALL queries
Underutilization of available workers in parallel plans
tuning_tips: Enable this setting when running queries with large UNION ALL operations and sufficient parallel worker capacity; disable only if async append plans cause unexpected resource contention or regressions in specific workloads.
